name: Tamuzakar
backstory: Child of Trezukar and Tamuzaken, in Terfila; grew up around walks the transit route between Terfila and the..., and picked up a little of Gorff along the way.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Tamuzco, named Trezukuzco.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Farliukar, named Tamuzukar.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Tamuzco has died.
Heard that Trezukar and Tamuzaken now have a child, Trezukaken.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Death Of Dorakus their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Death Of Dorakus as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes over more of the house's morning bookkeeping at the stalls, testing his own hand at pressing suppliers for better terms, and repeating the family's account of the dispute a little more confidently each time.

arc.premise: Tamuzakar has stopped chasing down the shortened version already circulating among travelers, and started raising a waystone along the transit route marking the death properly - carved, dated, impossible to thin out the way the retellings already have.
